findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web-search, web-scrape · Private data: base-balance, token-price, dns-lookup, erc20-meta, token-safety, wallet-risk, memory, extract, buy-credits, buy-credits-starter, buy-credits-pro · Public sink: ens-resolve · Destructive: batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web-search, web-scrape · Private data: base-balance, token-price, dns-lookup, erc20-meta, token-safety, wallet-risk, memory, extract, buy-credits, buy-credits-starter, buy-credits-pro · Public sink: ens-resolve · Destructive: batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
